purpose: Replace P0678's failed sampled-image derivative with the exact NIE Hessian requested from the comparator implementation and compare it to P0679's converged 0.01-arcsec direct derivative.

hessian.method: LensModel.hessian with diff=None, requesting exact derivatives when implemented

selection_rule: Qualify the P0678 spent required-field decomposition only if every exact-Hessian symmetry, direct-agreement, provenance, and no-score gate passes. Preserve P0678/P0679 as historical failures rather than rewriting their reports.
claim_boundary: P0680 qualifies numerical derivatives only; it does not validate the compact halo or a new gravity law.
The exact Hessian is evaluated on spent comparator parameters and cannot serve as a predictive input.
No raw root, candidate score, or sealed target is evaluated.
